g.text: The command exchange duration bounds have been set in the security settings,
per card profile, for the session opening, the session closing and the SV commands.
A bound is exceeded when the relevant command exchange alone lasts longer than it.
Bound exceeded inside a secure session
The exchange lasted longer than the bound set for the session opening:
a relay attack or a card emulation is suspected.
The open secure session is automatically cancelled before the error is raised:
the card keeps no trace of the interrupted transaction.
Bound exceeded outside a secure session
The exchange lasted longer than the bound set for the SV commands.
No secure session is open: only the error is raised.
The ticketing layer decides what to do, according to its own context.
